statements.t: As of September 30, 2026, the Company’s pro forma first lien net leverage ratio was 3.03x compared to a covenant ratio test of 4.75x and its total net leverage ratio was 4.04x, both calculated in accordance with the terms of its credit agreements which - beginning in the second quarter 2026 - exclude the synergies expected in connection with the acquisition of TEGNA (1) .
We are currently subject to a preliminary injunction that has impacted our ability to execute on synergies anticipated in connection with the acquisition of TEGNA.

For synergies to be recognized for our covenant ratio test, they must be anticipated to be realized within 18 months from the date of the transaction, which date would be September 19, 2027 (the “Outside Synergies Date”).
Given the limited time between the resolution of the trial and the Outside Synergies Date, we have removed the projected anticipated synergies from the leverage calculation.
If conditions change, we will revisit this assessment and calculation.
